entries.title: Immigration assessment integrity and visibility strengthened
entries.summary: Dynamic naturalization now provisions the complete civic profile and account relationship atomically and enforces one certificate per passed attempt. Certified citizens can use an authenticated, non-issuing practice assessment that cannot change the population. The Founder receives exact aggregate assessment analytics, while the civic wire and periodic Transparency Ledger summaries apply a five-completion privacy threshold to outcome counts. Individual answers, contact fields, and attempt identities remain private. All 82 release tests passed before publication.

changes: Repaired dynamic certificate issuance so the civic profile, credit account, login account, and citizen record are created in a valid dependency order
Enforced one passed naturalization attempt per certificate while preserving safe idempotent retries
Added an authenticated practice assessment for certified citizens that cannot issue a certificate or change population
Added exact lifetime, 30-day, and 7-day Immigration assessment aggregates to the Founder-authorized Editorial Studio analytics
Added a privacy-thresholded assessment activity item to the public civic wire
Added idempotent periodic aggregate Immigration assessment summaries to the Transparency Ledger
Kept individual attempts, answers, contact information, and identities out of the public ledger
Preserved the existing single-citizen population during migration and deployment
